description: datacarto.sigena.fr: wastewater datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by datacarto.sigena.fr. Coverage: the area served by datacarto.sigena.fr. The listing groups 13 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about wastewater; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Nouvelle-Aquitaine : TRI d'Agen - Enjeux liés aux stations de traiteme; Nouvelle-Aquitaine : TRI de Bergerac - Enjeux liés aux stations de tra; Nouvelle-Aquitaine : TRI de Pau - Enjeux liés aux stations de traiteme; Nouvelle-Aquitaine : TRI Tulle-Brive - Enjeux liés aux stations de tra. Formats seen: WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
